verdict.rationale: Cold-start latency and runtime weight are fair questions for a local inference runtime like Ollama, but the pack has no first-party documentation of fast cold start or a lightweight binary. The only on-topic community report (ollama-comm-10) says it 'takes a long while before it starts giving a result,' which runs against the story rather than supporting it. With no vendor claim to contradict, the verdict is none rather than disputed.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
